facts.note: Matthey's question places the watch inspection at the temple bell striking nine. Vauthier answers that Aurèle had everyone show their watches and that his was two minutes ahead of the bell. The timepiece and relation match. The nine o'clock timing comes through the question the doctor answers, not his own words.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by his watch; he went out to the hall for the cigar case in his coat; Odile began the piano as he went out and stopped when he came back. All stated with the same watch and sequence.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after he sat down again. Stated with the same clock and the same relation.
